title: The Regressor Fed Him to a Sea Monster, So He Took the Dokkaebi's Whole Channel . . . (Part 3)
caption:
Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Part 3: Dokja Kim meets the regressor Junghyeok Yu, who drops him into a sea serpent.
From inside its stomach he talks a dokkaebi into a deal that hands him every coin. Follow for part 4!

#omniscientreadersviewpoint #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #fyp
comment: Would you have trusted Junghyeok after he dropped you into a sea serpent, or walked away? Why?

segments.say: The regressor lets go of Dokja over a sea serpent, and the beast *swallows* him whole.
To see how it got here, go back to the zombie horde, where a man in a black coat just *arrived*.
He cuts through the dead like they are nothing, then grabs Dokja by the *throat*.
He wants one thing. A name. Dokja Kim, comes the answer, and the stranger says what a strange *name*.
But Dokja knows exactly who this is. Junghyeok Yu, the *regressor*, the most dangerous man in the whole story.
So Dokja tells the scariest guy alive he is older, so he should show some *respect*. Absolute madman energy.
A message pops up. Junghyeok has become *cautious* of you. Dokja just made the regressor nervous.
Then Dokja admits he is a fan. He read all three thousand episodes of Junghyeok's *journey*. He liked him, hated him, and cheered for him.
Junghyeok does not care. He will forgive the attitude, but he has one question. How did Dokja survive the *subway*?
If I tell you, will you let me live? Junghyeok says that depends on the *answer*.
So Dokja lies a little. He got lucky, he says, because he spotted the kid with the insects when the explosion made him *fall*.
Junghyeok does not buy it. A newbie this calm must have killed Namwoon Kim, which makes him useful, and very *dangerous*.
Dokja asks to be let go, because they are running out of time. Junghyeok says not so *fast*.
He uses his Eye of the Sage to read Dokja's stats, and Dokja's Fourth Wall *blocks* it.
Now Junghyeok is squeezing his neck and asking what the hell this guy *is*.
So Dokja switches plans. You need a trustworthy ally, he says, because you can't clear Scenario 46 on your *own*.
Junghyeok asks if he is a regressor too. Dokja says no, but he knows the future Junghyeok *doesn't*.
His lie detector says it is true, and Junghyeok starts to wonder if Dokja is a *prophet*.
So Dokja makes his offer. Make me your companion, and I will fill in the blanks of your *future*.
A prophet could help with Scenario 46 and everything after it, but can he be *trusted*?
The clock says forty seconds. Junghyeok decides. I will make you my *companion*.
Then he drags Dokja across the stairs like a *sack* of laundry, while Dokja wheezes.
Dokja thinks he pulled it off, and then Junghyeok stops. One last *question*.
If you are a prophet, he says, you can tell your own *future*.
Then a sea serpent rises behind them, and Junghyeok dangles him over the edge. *Prophesy*.
Dokja knows this psychopath better than anyone, so he sets terms. I am not your lackey. Treat me as your *equal*.
And just as I cooperate with you, you cooperate with me. Junghyeok asks for his *answer*.
Dokja tells him to let go and get lost, and Junghyeok does. He *lets go*.
I believe you, he says with a smile. You really are a prophet. And the serpent *swallows* him whole.
A message says he failed the scenario, and Dokja gasps awake inside the serpent's *stomach*.
He is not scared. This must be a test, and Junghyeok wants to see if he is *worth* it.
Then a fluffy little dokkaebi floats in and asks why Dokja isn't *panicking*. Because he has been waiting for it.
It wants his coins as a penalty, but the penalty says three question marks, not death, so there is room to *negotiate*.
The dokkaebi asks for 5,100 coins, every coin he has. Dokja says too expensive, so just *kill* me.
Then he calls the thing by name. Low-grade dokkaebi Bihyeong, how is your streaming *career*?
Bihyeong freaks out, because no human should know his name, and Dokja asks him to shut off the channel so they can *talk*.
Then he pitches it. Don't you want to be the Dokkaebi *King*? Sign a contract with me, and I will make you one.
Bihyeong laughs and calls him crazy, but Dokja does not want a sponsor. He wants the *channel*.
Constellations hop channels or hunt for a human to sponsor, so what if one human beats everyone with no *sponsor* at all?
Bihyeong stalls and says they should do the checkout, since Dokja failed. But Dokja says he did not *fail*.
Then a hidden scenario lights up. Kill the Sea Commander Ichthyosaur and escape, and nine thousand coins are *yours*.
The dokkaebi blames a server error and kills the stream, and Dokja uses the quiet to force open the cash *shop*.
He skips the dragon hearts and buys four bags of mucus and four sharp thorns. The dokkaebi wonders what the hell he needs *junk* for.
The Black Flame Dragon hates it and the Secretive Plotter is *curious*. Dokja says they will talk terms after he clears the scenario.
He smears the mucus on his skin, so the stomach acid cannot *melt* him.
Then he drives a stone hog thorn into the monster's insides, and the whole stomach *sparks* with lightning.
On the fourth day, the monster finally *dies*.
The hidden scenario ends with nine thousand coins, plus a thousand more for being the first to hunt a tier seven *monster*.
He lived on the monster's own fluid, sipped through the thorn, and it was a test of pure *willpower*.
Now the dokkaebi writes the contract. No sponsor, no other channel, and all profits *shared*.
But the contract forgot the ratio, so Dokja names it. Fifty-fifty? Nope, he takes all the *coins*.
The dokkaebi begs for seventy percent, Dokja says all or nothing, and the constellations start complaining about the *ads*.
So the dokkaebi gives in, and Dokja adds one more thing. Give me five thousand coins as a contract *fee*. Absolute menace.
Four days inside a monster, and Dokja walks out into fresh *air*, richer than before.
He even signed a stream contract with a dokkaebi. Not a bad *start*.
Then the dokkaebi tries to mess with his skills, and the Fourth Wall *blocks* even that.
A message says he has entered the second main scenario, and the air is full of *poison*.
The Black Flame Dragon smiles. The real game *begins* now.
